name: Cuddly Zebra 68
author: mrhyddenn
description: Gradient sky-blue button that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, background changes from linear-gradient(#4faefc,#006bff) to linear-gradient(#44aefc,#026bff), outline becomes 3px solid #4faefc.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Cuddly Zebra 68</title>
<style>
/* Cuddly Zebra 68 by mrhyddenn — https://uiverse.io/mrhyddenn/cuddly-zebra-68 */
button {
 width: 150px;
 padding: 4px 12px;
 border: none;
 border-radius: 7px;
 background: linear-gradient(#4faefc,#006bff);
 color: #fff;
 font-size: 17px;
 font-family: sans-serif;
}

button:focus {
 background: linear-gradient(#44aefc,#026bff);
 outline: 3px solid #4faefc;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> MacOS Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
